svg.text: TripUp wireflow · the Lisbon scenario in 10 screens

Lo-fi, iPhone 15 (393 × 852). Follow the numbered arrows. Diamonds are checks the app makes; callouts under each screen record the decision the user takes, the state that changes, and the pattern in play.

g.text: Tonight: dinner still open · You're owed €42
Live trip is the hero; the two soft chips are the next action and the money state.

svg.text: Which trip? The live one is promoted;
past trips collapse to a row.

g.text: Nic ORGANIZER · Ari · Maya · Theo · Sam [+]
3 places from the wishlist, ready to poll
Empty slot in today's plan = the one call to action. Money is a row, not a tab-jump.

svg.text: Today's open slot drives the CTA.

g.text: no install · no password · no profile
Ren's side (03b) is a browser page: phone + 4-digit code, then vote & pay from there.

svg.text: Link vs contacts. Link is default:

g.text: options ranked: saved by more › open now › walk › price
Taberna da Rua das Flores · €€ · 6 min
4 more on the wishlist · swap one in
AI drafts three options from the wishlist; every one is removable. No timer.

svg.text: search. Close rule: all voted / manual.

g.text: Ari asks: Where for dinner? Tap to vote
Every event has a push + a chat-card twin, so nobody has to open the app to vote.
Tonight 19:30 · asked by Ari · 4 of 6 voted
A N M S · T R (dimmed)
4 voted · Theo and Ren haven't yet
Closes when everyone has voted, or when you close it.
Votes arrive live: counts and bars animate, cards re-sort. Close is enabled once a majority exists.

svg.text: Wait for all 6, or close now

g.text: Ramiro it is. Added to tonight
After dinner · suggestion: Miradouro da Graça
Result lands in the itinerary automatically and is traceable (“from poll”). Next empty slot gets a suggestion.
Paid by you · 6 people · receipt scanned
AI note: Nic and Ren usually skip wine. Tap a name to change
Item-level exclusion, suggested from habits, never auto-applied.

Nic & Ren out of wine; editable.
